avoid_dishes.reason: Miso and marinade may contain barley or wheat unless it's on the GF menu

name: Zuma Dubai
questions: Is the gluten-free menu still available? Can I see it?
Do you serve tamari or GF soy at the table?
Are the robata glazes and ponzu GF?

safe_dishes.dish: Items on the GF menu (ask for it)
safe_dishes.note: Grilled meats, sushi and seafood reportedly included

summary: Guides report a dedicated GF menu, but the sources are older and nothing mentions tamari. Ask for the GF menu when booking.
tamari_source: A Bayut guide says Zuma offers a 'special gluten-free Japanese menu' covering grilled meats, sushi and seafood. A 2019 What's On guide says the same. No Dubai source mentions tamari, though a Zuma Istanbul reviewer reports GF soy sauce and a GF menu on request.
